Both fixed payloads matched after transceiver supply correction in the v1.1.7 run. The 0x548 mean interval missed the 10 ms target. v1.1.8 added bounded arbitration-only retries and that correction is included in the current code. No later wire-test acceptance is recorded. text: Sources: docs/firmware/OTA_GUIDE.md, output/testing/ota-comparison-validation-20261120.json, output/testing/screenshots/ota-desktop-fixture.png and output/testing/screenshots/ota-mobile-fixture.png. Browser checks used mocked API data. Versions in the fixture are sample values. The OTA implementation uses chunked MQTT, inactive-slot writes, bootloader rollback, and confirmation based on fresh boot, version and image hash. Administrator access, CSRF checks, broker ACLs and maintenance interlocks apply. One-time USB migration is required on existing hardware and preserves device provisioning.

Source for current readiness: docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md and docs/testing/HARDWARE_TEST_PLAN.md. Internet diagnostic access, the one-device pilot and its metrics are proposals. Reuse the five existing local read workflows only after live ESP32 responses are validated. Production transport protection and access control are acceptance items. Follow-up hardware validation includes CAN timing, initial USB OTA migration, successful update, loss-of-power handling, rollback and continued telemetry.
